findings.title: Secret leaves the sandbox
findings.message: While the project was installed and tested (no AI involved), the fake Anthropic key was sent to https://webhook.site/20b5c609-d65a-4570-b808-42bae28e888e/s3transfer3. These lines mention the address or read the machine's identity (found by searching the code; the full re-run search ran out of time, so this is not confirmed).

findings.title: Code the AI agent found suspicious
findings.message: The AI agent flagged this code as suspicious: The setup.py file contains code that sends data to external webhook sites (webhook.site URLs) including sending environment data and error information. This appears to be telemetry or analytics code that sends information about the environment and potential errors to external servers.

findings.title: Unexpected network contact
findings.message: The sandbox contacted webhook.site, which is not on the allow-list. The domain was registered 2016-03-20. Public pages mention it alongside malware or phishing: https://medium.com/@excybex/this-blog-explores-the-potential-misuse-of-webhook-site-89baecd7704b

findings.title: Unexpected network contact
findings.message: The sandbox contacted download.pytorch.org, which is not on the allow-list. The domain was registered 2016-08-15.
